items.exampleEn: It is not easy to obtain tickets for this concert.
items.exampleZh: 這場演唱會的票不容易取得。

items.exampleEn: The distribution of the free books starts at ten.
items.exampleZh: 免費書籍十點開始發放。

items.exampleEn: Please don't interrupt me while I'm on the phone.
items.exampleZh: 我在講電話時請不要打斷我。

items.exampleEn: Please leave the building by the nearest exit.
items.exampleZh: 請從最近的出口離開大樓。

items.exampleEn: Workers must wear protective glasses in the factory.
items.exampleZh: 工人在工廠裡必須戴護目鏡。

items.exampleEn: She used a clip to hold the papers together.
items.exampleZh: 她用夾子把文件夾在一起。

items.exampleEn: Put a coin in the slot, and the machine will give you a ticket.
items.exampleZh: 把硬幣投入投幣口，機器就會給你一張票。

items.sentenceEn: Sorry to interrupt, but your taxi is waiting outside.
items.sentenceZh: 抱歉打擾一下，你的計程車在外面等了。

items.audioEn: When the fire alarm rings, avoid the elevator and use the exit at the end of the hall.
items.audioZh: 火災警報響的時候，不要搭電梯，從走廊盡頭的出口離開。
items.questionZh: 火災警報響時應該怎麼做？
options: Take the elevator down to the first floor.
Use the exit at the end of the hall.
Wait quietly in the office until help comes.
Call the front desk right away.

items.sentenceEn: The food distribution will be in the park on Sunday.
items.sentenceZh: 食物發放會在星期天於公園進行。

items.sentenceEn: The door opens when you push your card into the slot.
items.sentenceZh: 把卡片插進卡槽，門就會打開。

items.stemZh: 植物透過根部吸收水分。

items.stemEn: You must wear ____ gloves when you work with hot metal.
items.stemZh: 處理高溫金屬時，你必須戴防護手套。

items.passageEn: Our office building has a new security system. Every worker must obtain a new card from the front desk. To open the main door, you push your card into the slot under the screen. The distribution of the cards will finish on Friday. If you lose your card, wait at the side door and call the front desk. Please wear your card on your shirt with a clip so everyone can see it. Sorry to interrupt your busy week, and thank you for your help.
items.passageZh: 我們的辦公大樓有新的門禁系統。每位員工都必須到櫃台領取新卡。要打開大門，就把卡片插進螢幕下方的卡槽。卡片會在星期五發完。如果你的卡遺失了，請到側門等候，並打電話給櫃台。請用夾子把卡片別在上衣上，讓大家都看得到。抱歉在忙碌的一週打擾大家，謝謝各位配合。

questions.questionZh: 卡片遺失的話要怎麼做？

items.promptZh: 很抱歉打斷你們的談話。
referenceEn: I'm sorry to interrupt your conversation.
rubricZh: interrupt 表示「打斷」，後面可直接接受詞（例如 interrupt your conversation）
「很抱歉⋯」可寫 I'm sorry to…、Sorry for＋動名詞等

items.instructionZh: 用 obtain 造一個句子，說說你曾經在哪裡取得某樣東西（例如證件、資料或票）。
referenceEn: I obtained my passport at an office in Taipei.
I obtained the information from the library website.
rubricZh: obtain 表示「取得、獲得」，後面接取得的東西
過去的經驗可用過去式或現在完成式（例如 obtained）
可用 at、from 等說明地點或來源
